title: Zayıflamışsın

characters.GRANDMA: a small round grandmother in her seventies with white hair in a bun, wearing a lavender cardigan and a flowery apron
characters.GRANDSON: a young man of about twenty-five with curly brown hair, wearing a teal jacket

scenes.text:
Ninen seni neden her gördüğünde
"Zayıflamışsın" der, hiç düşündün mü?
scenes.prompt: At the wooden gate of a small village house in autumn, {GRANDMA} welcomes {GRANDSON} with open arms and a big smile, golden leaves falling from a big walnut tree.

scenes.text:
Kapıdan girer girmez sofraya oturtur,
tabağını iki kez doldurur.
scenes.prompt: In a cozy village kitchen, {GRANDSON} sits at a table full of dishes with a full plate in front of him, while {GRANDMA} stands beside the table smiling proudly, warm window light.

scenes.text:
Sen "Kilo aldım nine" desen de
ikna olmaz, başını sallar.
scenes.prompt: In the cozy kitchen, {GRANDSON} on the left laughs and shakes his head, while {GRANDMA} on the right looks at him doubtfully with her arms crossed, a smile hiding on her face.

scenes.text:
Onun gözünde azalan kilon değil,
ziyaretlerin.
scenes.prompt: At sunset, {GRANDMA} stands alone at the window of the village house, looking out at the empty road, autumn leaves drifting past, a warm lamp glowing behind her.

scenes.text:
Bu hafta git, bırak seni doyursun.
Bunu ninesini özleyen birine gönder.
scenes.prompt: At sunset, {GRANDSON} arrives at the wooden garden gate with a travel bag on his shoulder, and {GRANDMA} hurries out of the house toward him smiling, golden autumn leaves falling.

caption:
Nineni özledin mi?

Onun "Zayıflamışsın"ı aslında "Geç kaldın" demek. 🤍

Bunu ninesini özleyen birine gönder.
